about.subtitle: Exploring for metals on the doorstep of the European Union
about.introDescription: Yugo Metals owns 100% of three exploration projects comprising five tenements in Bosnia and Herzegovina, on the doorstep of the European Union. Our projects have a history of high-grade mineral discovery and are prospective for gold, antimony, nickel, copper, and cobalt - essential metals for the energy transition and European supply security.
about.reasonsTitle: Six Reasons to Invest in Yugo Metals
about.reason1Description: Bosnia and Herzegovina is an EU accession state with a land border to the European Union, offering strategic access to European markets.
about.reason2Description: The Balkans is one of the world's oldest mining areas, with proven mineral wealth and infrastructure.
about.reason3Description: Yugo Metals owns 100% of all three projects comprising five tenements, providing complete control and upside potential.
about.reason4Description: Projects explored sporadically during Yugoslav regime but never subjected to modern systematic exploration.
about.reason5Description: Highly skilled workforce, extensive existing infrastructure, and supportive regulatory environment.
about.reason6Description: Targeting gold, antimony, nickel, and copper - essential metals for the energy transition and European supply security.
about.modernExplorationParagraph1: Yugo Metals has developed a two-year technical work program, including systematic ground work, geophysical surveys, and drilling. The project was explored sporadically during the Yugoslav era, but has never been subjected to modern systematic exploration, presenting significant discovery potential.
about.modernExplorationParagraph2: The exploration program focuses on identifying and delineating high-grade mineralisation using modern exploration techniques and technologies. The region boasts excellent infrastructure and a highly skilled workforce, supporting efficient exploration activities.
about.highlight1: 100% ownership of three projects comprising five tenements
about.highlight2: Strategic location in EU accession state
about.highlight4: Never subjected to modern systematic exploration
about.highlight5: Rich mining history with pro-mining environment
about.highlight6: Focus on critical metals: nickel, copper, cobalt

board.title: Board of Directors
board.subtitle: Experienced leadership team
board.description: Our board brings together decades of combined experience in mining exploration, corporate governance, and capital markets. Their leadership guides Yugo Metals' strategic direction and commitment to delivering value to shareholders.
board.director1Bio:
David has more than 30 years of Senior Executive Management, Directorships, and Corporate Advisory experience. He is a foundation Director and Partner of Pathways Corporate, a boutique Corporate Advisory firm that undertakes assignments on behalf of family offices, private clients, and ASX listed companies.

David has engaged in business projects in the USA, UK, Europe, NZ, China, Malaysia, Singapore and the Middle East. David is a Fellow of the Australian Institute of Company Directors and has experience on public and private company boards, currently holding a number of Directorships and Advisory positions in Australian companies.
board.director2Bio:
Mr Tomasevic is a multilingual leader with a diverse background. Specializing in future metals, mineral acquisition, and asset implementation, Petar brings a deep understanding of the mining and financing sector to his role with Yugo Metals.

Prior to his current role, Petar served as Director at Fenix Resources Ltd (ASX: FEX), playing a pivotal role in the company's transformation into a premium iron ore producer. He was instrumental in restructuring and financing Fenix's acclaimed Iron Ridge project. Petar currently serves as a Non-Executive Director for both GTI Energy Ltd (ASX: GTR) and Regenerate Resources Ltd (ASX: R8R).
board.director3Bio: Mr McNab is a Chartered Accountant and Fellow member of the Governance Institute of Australia (Chartered Secretary) with over 15 years' experience in the resources industry and accounting profession in Australia, New Zealand and the UK. Mr McNab currently holds CFO and Company Secretary positions with various ASX listed companies and brings strong experience across corporate.
board.director4Bio:
Mr Stevanovic is a geologist with over 20 years experience across a number of commodities including precious metals (gold, silver, platinum), base metals (nickel, copper, chromite, lead, zinc and antimony) and uranium.

Mr Stevanovic has held senior roles at major and junior international mining companies. He has led exploration teams that made significant discoveries in Europe, Australia and Africa. He has experience in managing JORC compliant exploration campaigns, resource estimates, metallurgical testwork and feasibility studies. Mr Stevanovic is Competent Person for reporting geological results on ASX, and accredited statutory supervisor in Western Australia and Bosnia-Herzegovina.

governance.title: Corporate Governance
governance.subtitle: Commitment to transparency and best practices
governance.frameworkContent:
Yugo Metals is committed to maintaining the highest standards of corporate governance. Our governance framework is designed to ensure transparency, accountability, and ethical conduct across all aspects of our operations.

We adhere to the ASX Corporate Governance Council's Corporate Governance Principles and Recommendations, and regularly review our governance practices to ensure they remain current and effective.
governance.boardContent: Our Board of Directors is responsible for the strategic direction and oversight of Yugo Metals. The Board comprises experienced professionals with diverse backgrounds in mining, finance, and governance.
governance.policiesContent:
We maintain comprehensive governance policies covering all aspects of our operations, including:

  • Code of Conduct
  • Risk Management Framework
  • Continuous Disclosure Policy
  • Trading Policy
  • Diversity Policy
  • Whistleblower Policy
